{{Short description|Peruvian chemist}}
'''Gastón Pons Muzzo''' ([[Wiktionary:circa|circa]] 1922 &ndash; January 6, 2004) was a [[Peru]]vian [[chemist]].

He was born in [[Tacna]], [[Peru]] and joined [[National University of San Marcos]] staff in the 1960s to lecture [[chemistry|general chemistry]] [[laboratory]] at the Department of Chemistry.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Tolentino |first=Scheila |date=2023-07-15 |title=San Marcos: ¿cuándo se inauguró el comedor universitario y cuál fue el primer menú que sirvió? |url=https://larepublica.pe/sociedad/2023/07/15/san-marcos-cuando-se-inauguro-el-comedor-de-la-unmsm-y-cual-fue-el-primer-menu-que-sirvio-evat-617355 |access-date=2023-12-20 |website=larepublica.pe |language=es}}</ref> He also was known for his teaching of physical chemistry and for his accompanying textbook. He was elected as [[dean (education)|dean]] in 1964 and remained in office until 1967.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Tauro |first=Alberto |title=Enciclopedia ilustrada del Perú: síntesis del conocimiento integral del Perú, desde sus orígenes hasta la actualidad |date=2001 |publisher=PEISA, Promoción Ed. Inca S.A |isbn=978-9972-40-149-7 |location=Lima}}</ref>

He was elected as president of [[Chemical Society of Peru]] between 1974 and 1977 and was [[rector magnificus]] of the university. In 1985, when his term ended, he was awarded by then Peru's official [[treasury|secretary of treasury]], ''Miguel Ángel Cusiánovich'', in recognition of his role as rector.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Tolentino |first=Scheila |date=2023-07-15 |title=San Marcos: ¿cuándo se inauguró el comedor universitario y cuál fue el primer menú que sirvió? |url=https://larepublica.pe/sociedad/2023/07/15/san-marcos-cuando-se-inauguro-el-comedor-de-la-unmsm-y-cual-fue-el-primer-menu-que-sirvio-evat-617355 |access-date=2023-12-20 |website=larepublica.pe |language=es}}</ref>

Before his retirement from [[National University of San Marcos]], he was appointed to another term in Peru's chemical society from 1988 to 1989. During the late 1990s, he was elected president of the commission which eventually established ''"María Inmaculada de Magdalena University"'', but health problems led him retire.  

He died on January 6, 2004, in [[Lima]], [[Peru]] at the age of 81.<ref>{{Cite web |last=PERÚ |first=Empresa Peruana de Servicios Editoriales S. A. EDITORA |date=2016-01-06 |title=Químico peruano Gastón Pons Muzzo murió un día como hoy |url=https://andina.pe/agencia/noticia-quimico-peruano-gaston-pons-muzzo-murio-un-dia-como-hoy-592708.aspx |access-date=2023-12-20 |website=andina.pe |language=es}}</ref>

== Publications ==

* ''Physicochemistry'' (1st edition, 1969; 6th edition: Editorial Universo, Lima, 1985), university course.
* ''General chemistry. SI version'' (Editorial Bruño, Lima, 1987).
* ''285 solved problems of General Chemistry. SI version'' (Asociación Editorial Stella, Lima, 1992), complement to the previous work.
* ''Chemistry-Physics Treatise'' (2000).
